name: LEVETIRACETAM 500 MG 60 TABLETS
description: Levetiracetam is an antiepileptic drug used to treat seizures in people with epilepsy. It works in the brain to slow down the electrical signals that cause seizures. The drug is available under the generic name levetiracetam and brand names such as Keppra. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
